title.zh: 【日本财务省设立国债上链研究会，10 月 8 日召开首次会议】
title.en: 【日本财务省设立国债上链研究会，10 月 8 日召开首次会议】

current_state.zh: Japan's Ministry of Finance has established a study group on putting government bonds on-chain, with five academic and industry members plus the Bank of Japan and FSA as observers, holding its first closed-door meeting on October 8 and planning to compile its findings between December 2026 and January 2027.
current_state.en: Japan's Ministry of Finance has established a study group on putting government bonds on-chain, with five academic and industry members plus the Bank of Japan and FSA as observers, holding its first closed-door meeting on October 8 and planning to compile its findings between December 2026 and January 2027.
